{{Top|leg}}
A '''rock spitter''' was a type of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] launcher for [[magma missile]]s, carried alongside [[Plasma cannon/Legends|plasma cannons]] aboard their [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].<ref name="SbS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>

Reflecting their role, rock spitters were sometimes simply called [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile tubes]].<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> Though mainly seen on larger warships, they were also used by [[Slayer ship]]s.<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
It is not clear whether the rock spitter should be considered along with the plasma cannon as a variety of [[Yaret-Kor]]. ''Star by Star'' and ''Destiny's Way'' make a distinction between the two systems, but ''The Unifying Force'' uses the terms almost interchangeably.
